runs.conclusion: The enter-hook write site is not the reason the scissor is empty: r21's every-frame write was active and the box still came out zero-wide 225 times. The cause is static: main+0xa4b390 reads mask+0xa0 bits 0-3 as the y and x anchor modes, mode 3 collapses an axis to zero extent, and the class factory leaves those bits as the freshly allocated block had them (it writes (word & 0xfffff000) | 0xff0). Left == right with the height ours is the x-collapsed, y-spanning signature, shared by r14, r18, r20 and r22. The enter handler's bit 1 rebuilds +0xb0..+0xbc from that quad every frame, which is why writing the rectangle words (r18, r20, r22) never moved the scissor. r23 clears the modes and lets the game rebuild. The run also proved the walker's liveness check firing and re-arming once, in a live session.
